tests.procedure: Under strong white light check each received container separately in a clean transparent watch glass or glass dish for foreign particles, colour and conformity. Hygroscopicity: in a glass weighing vessel, weigh about 2 g (m1, m2), stand unstoppered 24 h at 25 +/- 1 C, stopper and weigh (m3); percentage increase in mass: 15 % or more very hygroscopic; 2 % to 15 % hygroscopic; less than 2 % slightly hygroscopic.

details.reference: BP 2024 (SC IV K.) Characters Section in Monographs (Hygroscopicity and Solubility)

tests.procedure: Stepwise solubility at 25.0 +/- 0.5 C: 100 mg sample with 0.1 mL solvent, then 0.9 mL, 2 mL and 7 mL more (shake 1 min, hold 15 min each step); if still undissolved, 10 mg in 10 mL (slightly soluble), then 1 mg in 10 mL (very slightly soluble), else practically insoluble. Repeat with the other solvents.
IR: mix the sample intimately with potassium bromide, compress into a transparent pellet, and compare the spectrum with that of croscarmellose sodium RS.
Mix 1 g sample with 100 mL of a 4 ppm (1 in 250,000) methylene blue solution, stir, and allow to settle. Expected: the sample absorbs the methylene blue and settles as a blue, fibrous mass.

On the residue from the sulfated ash test: dissolve in 2 mL water; add 2 mL of 150 g/L potassium carbonate; heat to boiling (no precipitate); add 4 mL potassium pyroantimonate solution; heat to boiling; cool in iced water. A dense white precipitate is formed.
Put 1 g sample in a 250 mL beaker, add 100 mL CO2-free water, stir 5 min, measure with a calibrated pH meter.

details.reference: BP 2024 Appendix V L (Determination of pH Values)

tests.procedure: Disperse 10.00 g in 800.0 mL water (W1), stir 1 min every 10 min for the first 30 min, stand 1 h (centrifuge if necessary). Decant 200.0 mL supernatant, filter, collect 150.0 mL filtrate in a tared 250 mL beaker (W2), evaporate to dryness, dry residue at 100-105 C for 4 h, weigh (W3). Result = ((W3 - W2) x 100 x 100) / (W1 x (100 - LOD)).

Weigh a previously dried (105 C) weighing bottle (W0); weigh 1.000 g sample into it (W1); dry in calibrated oven at 105 C for 6 h, cool in desiccator, weigh (W2); repeat to constant weight. % LOD = (W1 - W2) / (W1 - W0) x 100.

details.reference: BP 2024 Appendix IX D (Determination of Loss on Drying)

tests.procedure: Ignite empty crucible at 600-650 C and cool in desiccator (W0). Weigh 1.0 g of the dried substance from the LOD test (W1). Moisten with about 1 mL sulfuric acid, heat gently until charred, moisten again, heat until white fumes stop, ignite in muffle at 600-650 C, cool in desiccator, weigh (W2); repeat to constant weight. % = (W2 - W0) / (W1 - W0) x 100.

details.reagent: sulfuric acid, about 1 mL per moistening

tests.procedure: Place 1.000 g in a 500 mL flask with 300 mL of 100 g/L sodium chloride; add 25.0 mL 0.1 M sodium hydroxide; stand 5 min; add 0.25 mL m-cresol purple; add about 15 mL 0.1 M hydrochloric acid, then 1 mL portions of 0.1 M HCl to yellow; back-titrate with 0.1 M sodium hydroxide to violet. Calculate milliequivalents M of base; A = 1150 x M / (7102 - 412 x M - 80 x C); S = (162 + 58 x A) x C / (7102 - 80 x C), where C = sulfated ash %; degree of substitution = A + S.
Place 75 mL water in a 100 mL graduated cylinder; add 1.5 g sample in 0.5 g portions, shaking after each; dilute to 100.0 mL with water; shake until homogeneous; stand 4 h; read the settling volume.

Aseptic technique under validated LAF. Weigh about 10 g sample and suspend in phosphate buffer 7.2 to 500 mL; process within 1 h. Pipette 1 mL of the dilution into each of two plates of SCDA (TAMC, 30-35 C, 3-5 days) and two plates of SDA (TYMC, 20-25 C, 5-7 days). Average the counts; total count (CFU/g) = (colonies plate 1 + colonies plate 2) / 2 x DF, DF = 50.

details.limit: Not more than 10^3 CFU/g (STM and spec read 103)
details.reference: USP 2024 <61> Microbiological Examination of Nonsterile Products: Microbial Enumeration Tests

tests.procedure: Same preparation and plates as TAMC (see TAMC): SDA plates incubated 5-7 days at 20-25 C.

details.limit: Not more than 10^2 CFU/g (STM and spec read 102)
details.reference: USP 2024 <61> Microbiological Examination of Nonsterile Products: Microbial Enumeration Tests

tests.procedure: Take 50 mL of the prepared PhB, add 100 mL SCDB, incubate 30-35 C 18-24 h; transfer 1 mL to 100 mL MacConkey broth, incubate 42-44 C 24-48 h; subculture on MacConkey agar 30-35 C 18-72 h. Confirm colonies: Gram stain (gram-negative short rods), EMB (dark centred colonies), TBX (blue or green colonies at 42-44 C), and identification system (report if probability above 70 %).

details.reference: USP 2024 <62> Microbiological Examination of Nonsterile Products: Tests for Specified Microorganisms

details.note: Held back: no method in the STM
